forfeitRaisesInvoice.title: A forfeited penalty raises an invoice
forfeitRaisesInvoice.description: When an enforcement act on a case of this type is forfeited, the finance app raises an invoice for the forfeited amount, linked to the case and payable online.

forfeitPayerRoleType.title: Who pays a forfeited penalty
forfeitPayerRoleType.description: The role type of the person on the case who receives the invoice, for example the offender. Without one, or when that person has no email address, no invoice is raised.

forfeitAdministration.title: Finance administration
forfeitAdministration.description: The administration in the finance app that sends the invoice.

forfeitRequestType.title: Kind of payment
forfeitRequestType.description: The kind of payment the finance app books the invoice under, which decides its revenue account.
